system.description:
Use this skill when you are attacked while [Pre-Action]. After the current Main Process ends, you may immediately begin your Main Process. You may not declare [Standby] through this effect. If it is already in the [Standby] state, the [Standby] state is canceled immediately.

A special skill that negates an enemy's attack and uses that momentum to immediately prepare for a counterattack. The reaction is lightning fast.
